opening.argument: The presentation ties a $3,500 Bitcoin package directly to passive revenue, stating, “I'll calculate passive revenue on a $3,500 package.” It then presents the mining calculation as a substantial return: “In total of 960 days we earn 20 507.4$ and this only with Bitcoin mining,” alongside a stated daily income of $26. The account and mining-pool displays, including a BitClub-branded earnings page and a calculator, give the projected return an appearance of financial support. The speaker further directs viewers to the link below the video for continuing team information. These elements connect a paid mining offer, projected earnings, and continued engagement, although the available evidence does not establish that the displayed earnings were accurate or realized.
